"Build a game where titans are attacking people who are living behind a massive walls and they are divided into three named (Maria,rose,sina) the walls are build in circle outer the walls there are many kind of titan whichs controlled by zeke yeager (beast titan) zeke yeager is the brother of eren yeager (attack titan) ther are 7 different kinds of titan they are controlled by the players they are war hammer titan,beast titan,attack titan,female titan, armored titan,collosal titan (this titan is bigger compared to all other titan) , Jay titan and at the last founding titan this titan can only be acquired by the players by collecting or defeating all the other titans . Now let's create the theme page of the game before entering into the game show a girl sits under a big tree near a tomb stone named eren yeager and crying . Show play button exit ,resume,andsettings button when the player touched the play button directly he must enter into the loading page showing Levi attacking the titan and the titan could only be defeated by the player only attacking it from behind (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style titan battle game for phones and tablets, including a title scene before gameplay.

## Requirements
- Title scene: a girl crying under a large tree beside a tombstone named “Eren Yeager”; show Play, Exit, Resume, and Settings.
- Play leads to a loading page showing Levi attacking a Titan; gameplay must require attacking the Titan from behind.
- Include circular walls named Maria, Rose, and Sina, Zeke/Beast Titan context, and seven player Titans, with the Founding Titan unlocked after collecting/defeating all seven.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML canvas game with custom-drawn, stylized 3D-perspective scenes and no external game engine.
- “Exit” currently returns to the title; “Jay Titan” is included as one of the seven, while the Founding Titan is the completion reward.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with title scene, responsive UI, settings modal, loading transition, canvas-rendered battlefield, keyboard and touch controls, Titan combat, save/resume, and completion/failure screens.
- Implemented behind-the-nape strike validation and seven sequential Titan encounters with localStorage progress.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser; check rendering and gameplay, fix any issues, and capture a screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open and test `index.html` in a browser at desktop and mobile sizes.
2. Fix any runtime/rendering issues and verify loading, movement, dodging, rear strikes, all seven Titans, and resume/settings.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no browser validation or screenshot has been performed yet.
